name: Copper Country Cubing Fall 2019

venue.name: Michigan Tech Memorial Union Building
venue.address: Michigan Tech Memorial Union Building, Houghton, MI 49931, United States
venue.details: Different rooms at different times over three floors, follow signs!

information: This will be the second Copper Country Cubing (Michigan Technological University) competition, in Michigan's great Upper Peninsula. The Memorial Union Building (MUB) is located between the middle and west end of the Michigan Tech campus. Check the schedule to see if the events at that time will be in the second floor ballroom, first floor alumni lounge, or ground floor commons. We are excited to be bringing all 18 official WCA events to the area, which doesn't get many competitions. The first CCC competition had only 8 events and 23 competitors, so this time we're making it bigger and better! Friday is reserved for big BLD and feet, so you can arrive just for Saturday and Sunday if you aren't interested in that subset of events.
